column1: # The 146 public ENA read sets the two reference sets called differently, out of the 4,042 of the
# at-scale sweep. This is the population behind every head-to-head figure on the wiki's "Validation at
# scale" page, shipped so those figures can be checked -- three of them had drifted from it.
# submitted      the ENA submitter label, normalised to a binomial. "Brucella sp." means the submitter
#                named no species, so neither call can be judged right or wrong at species level.
# vsnp_*         what --reference-set vsnp called it, and the distance and shared hashes behind that
# extended_*     the same for the 432-genome default set
# Distances are as the sweep measured them, under the pre-2.1 k-mer copy threshold.
# scripts/score_public_sweep.py derives the figures from this file.
